verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              वाराह एष कथितो नारसिंहमतः शृणु। यत्र भूत्वा मृगेन्द्रेण हिरण्यकशिपुर्हतः॥१॥
verses.english: He who created the three sorts of ambrosial life principle sudhA - in the triad of worlds; who made the brAhmaNa-s as the officiators to oblate हव्या-s – for gods, and कव्या-s - for manes, and who simultaneously made gods and ancestors as the receivers of those offerings...

verses.sanskrit: पुरा कृतयुगे राजन्हिरण्यकशिपुः प्रभुः। दैत्यानामादिपुरुषश्चकार सुमहत्तपः॥२॥
verses.english: Later, on eradicating all those that are clinging to materialism or its other shades - भाविन-अर्थेन चोदितान् – विष्णु will relinquish his कल्कि incarnation at the medial province of the rivers गन्ग and यमुन...
verses.bhavadeepa: वराह एषः मृगेन्द्रेण नृसिंहेण भूत्वा आविर्भूय॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: दश वर्षसहस्राणि शतानि दश पञ्च च। जलवासी समभवत्स्थानमौनव्रतस्थितः॥३॥
verses.english: The scholars in the Vedic lore describe him as having umpteen numbers of eyes, faces, feet, heads, mouths, tongues, arms and crowns; as eternal, self-effulgent, a giver of umpteen presents... and as an imperishable – अव्ययम्; as well as an immutable – अव्ययम् – entity...

verses.sanskrit: ततः शमदमाभ्यां च ब्रह्मचर्येण चैव हि। ब्रह्मा प्रीतोऽभवत्तस्य तपसा नियमेन च॥४॥
verses.english: He is: सवन= particular time for particular rite; हवन= particular deed in rituals; हव्यं= material oblated; होता= ritual-owner; पात्राणि= sacred places of ritual spread with kusha grass; पवित्राणि= straining vessel; वेदि= altar; दीक्षा= ritual vow; चरु= plates; स्रुव= wooden pestle; स्रुक्= ladles; सोम= soma creeper’s juice; शूर्प= winnowing flat baskets; मुसलं = grinding wooden shaft; प्रोक्षणं= vessels of anointment; दक्षिण= donations; अयनम्= हविस्, oblated material; यूपं= sacrificial post; समित्= firewood; कुशं= sacred grass; दर्वीं= leafy bowls; चमस= wooden beakers; उलूखलानि= wooden mortars, grinders; प्राक्-वंशं= sacred fore ground; यज्ञ-भूमि= ritual place; होतारं= रित्विक्-s, officiators; चयनं= level squares piece of ground made of bricks prepared for a sacrifice; ह्रस्वानि= short; अति-प्रमाणानि= huge; चराणि स्थावराणि= movement places, sheds; प्रायः-चित्तानि= atonements; अर्थं = fruits of action, heavens etc; स्थण्डिलानि= offertory grain; कुश= sacred grass; मन्त्रं= chanted hymn; यज्ञ-वहं वह्निं= ritual-carrier-fire, fire that carries sacrificial offerings; भागं= apportions; भाग-वहं= गायत्रि etc metres; अग्रे-भुजं= primary haulage of offered items by fire on his shoulders to respective gods; सोम-भुजं= nectarean haulage of offertories - names of fire; घृत-अर्चिषम्= oblation of ghee into fire; उदायुधम्= उदयनीयम्= another kind of fire-haulage... why one or two items of ritual, every bit of vedic ritual is हरि, so say the scholars in veda-s...
verses.bhavadeepa: स्थातुं शीलमस्येति स्थानं नन्द्यादिल्युप्रत्ययान्तः तद्वन्मौनं स्थानमौनम्॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वयम्भूर्भगवान्त्स्वयमागत्य तत्र ह। विमानेनार्कवर्णेन हंसयुक्तेन भास्वता॥५॥
verses.english: That intelligent Lord of gods, Vishnu, having the emblem of श्रीवत्स-jewel on his breast, incarnated himself in thousands of forms, and thousands of his incarnations shall take place in future, so said brahma. O great king, I shall describe at length, as accosted by you, the sacred and celestial theme, why the divine lord Vishnu, the king of gods and the slayer of his enemies, took his birth leaving the celestial region, in the family of वसु-देव. For accomplishment of the well-being of the gods and humans, which in turn is the prosperity of total worlds, and for accomplishment of such a deed, that supreme-soul of all beings went through various incarnations...

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यैर्वसुभिः साध्यैर्मरुद्भिदैवतैः सह। रुद्रैर्विश्वसहायैश्च यक्षराक्षसकिन्नरैः॥६॥
verses.english: Such as he is sage vishvamitra endowed him with many missiles for the destruction of the enemies of the gods, namely demons, who at that time are hindering the vedic-rituals of the self-controlled ascetics, and who have become unmanageable even unto those gods...

verses.sanskrit: दिग्भिश्चाथ विदिग्मिश्च नदीभिः सागरैस्तथा। नक्षत्रैश्च मुहूर्तैश्च खेचरेश्च महाग्रहैः॥७॥
verses.english: That being the legend of boar-incarnation, now listen to an account of his man-lion incarnation where assuming the form of a man-lion he eliminate the demon named हिरण्य- कशिपु॥।

verses.sanskrit: देवैर्ब्रह्मर्षिभिः सार्धं सिद्धैः सप्तर्षिभिस्तथा। राजर्षिभिः पुण्यकृद्भिर्गन्धर्वैरप्सरोगणैः॥८॥
verses.english: On reposing for a thousand eras, he restarts the work of creation afresh... then he manifests himself as:

verses.sanskrit: चराचरगुरुः श्रीमान्वृतो देवगणैः सह। ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां श्रेष्ठो दैत्यं वचनमब्रवीत्॥९॥
verses.english: Thus have I described the dwarf-boy incarnation of विष्णु to you, which the vedic-scholars of yore narrate as the magnificence of विष्णु...

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मोवाच।
              प्रीतोऽस्मि तव भक्तस्य तपसाऽनेन सुव्रत। वरं वरय भद्रं ते यथेष्टं काममाप्नुहि॥१०॥
verses.english: When the world is dissolved purging all the mobile and sessile, gods, demons, reptiles, ogres, two unassailable demons named मधु and कैटभ hid themselves under deep waters planning to wage war against shrIhari... whereupon shrIhari confronted and eliminated them conferring the boon of final liberation on them...

verses.sanskrit: ततो हिरण्यकशिपुः प्रीतात्मा दानवोत्तमः। कृताञ्जलिपुटः श्रीमान्वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्॥११॥
verses.english: The gods and sages are termed as पुष्करा-s because they are manifest from brahma, who manifested from the golden lotus with thousand petals, which in turn is a manifest from the naval of कमल-नाभ, say shrIhari, while he is reposing on the oceanic waters... this is how the purANA-s, that echo the teachings of veda-s and shruti-s, tell us...

verses.sanskrit:
हिरण्यकशिपुरुवाच।
              न देवासुरगन्धर्वा न यक्षोरगराक्षसाः। न मानुषाः पिशाचाश्च निहन्युर्मो कथञ्चन॥१२॥
verses.english: On hearing about the grant of boons to हिरण्य-कशिपु, then the gods, नागा-s, गन्धर्वा-s, sages et al have rushed to brahma, and they appealed to him keeping indra in the forefront...

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयो नैव मां क्रुद्धाः सर्वलोकपितामह। शपेयुस्तपसा युक्ता वर एष वृतो मया॥१३॥
verses.english: वेद-पाद= 4 veda-s are boar’s four feet; यूप-दंष्ट्र= columns of rituals are its fangs; क्रतु-दन्त= rituals its teeth; चिती-मुख= fireplace its face; अग्नि-जिह्व= fire its tongue; दर्भ-रोम= sacred grass its bodily hair; ब्रह्म-शीर्ष= head is brahma; अहो-रात्रा-ईक्षण= day and night are its eyes; divyo वेदाङ्ग-श्रुति-भूषण= divine ancillaries of veda-s and scriptures are its ornaments; आज्य-नास= oblational ghee is its nose; स्रुवा-तुण्ड= oblational vessels are its snout; साम-घोष-स्वन= chanting of सम veda is its sound; धर्म-सत्य-मय= boar is an embodiment of virtue and truth, like total vedic ritual; क्रम-विक्रम-सत्कृत= knower of the line of actions; प्रायश्चित्त-नख= atonements its nails; पशु-जानु= its thighs and knees are sacrificial animals; उद्गात्र् अन्तो होम-लिन्ङ्गः फल-बीज-महौषधिः= while उद्गात, होम-s etc of the ritual are the fruits, seeds and herbs of यज्ञ, they are denominative of boar’s testicles – फल= testicles, बीज- semen, औषधि= life-enrichers, progeny; वाय्व्-अन्तरात्मा= air its inner soul; मन्त्र-स्फिग्विकृत= trunk is hymnal centre – मन्त्र स्थानीयम्; सोम शोणित= soma juice is its blood; वेदि-स्कन्ध= fire altar is its nape of the neck; हविर्-गन्ध= oblational fragrance is its smell-faculty; हव्य-कव्य अति-वेगवान्= हव्या-s and कव्या-s are its fast pace; प्राग्वंश-काय= प्राग्वंशम् of ritual is its body; द्युतिमान् नाना दीक्षा अभिराचित= various ritual vows are its effulgence; दक्षिणा-हृदय= donations in rituals are its heart; उपाकर्म ओष्ठ= ancillary rituals are its lips; रुचकः प्रवर्ग्य आवर्त-भूषण= प्रवर्ग etc procedures are its beautiful adornments; नाना छन्दो-गति-पथ= numerous meters are its get going; गुह्य उपनिषद् आसन= unrevealable उपनिशद्-s are its seat; छाया-पत्नी-सहाय = its own shadow is his wife – because yaj~na is not for the wifeless; मेरु-शृण्ग इव उच्छ्रित= like an immense yaj~na his form is loftiest like the peak of Mt. मेरु.

verses.sanskrit: न शस्त्रेण न चास्त्रेण गिरिणा पादपेन च। न शुष्केण न चार्द्रेण स्यान्न चान्येन मे वधः॥१४॥
verses.english: After the termination of the कलि-युग the सत्य-युग will again appear in due order. This is the outcome of the natural sequence and there can no perversion of it.

verses.sanskrit: न स्वर्गेऽप्यथ पाताले नाकाशे नावनिस्थले। न चाभ्यन्तररात्र्यह्नोर्न चाप्यन्येन मे वधः॥१५॥
verses.english: That being the legend of boar-incarnation, now listen to an account of his man-lion incarnation where assuming the form of a man-lion he eliminate the demon named हिरण्य- कशिपु॥।

verses.sanskrit: पाणिप्रहारेणैकेन सभृत्यबलवाहनम्। यो मां नाशयितुं शक्तः स मे मृत्युर्भविष्यति॥१६॥
verses.english: I shall describe the sacred and celestial incarnations of the lord fraught with many virtues that have been recorded in metres and great श्रुति-s. Purifying yourself and controlling your speech, listen to them, O janamejaya. This highly sacred purANA is equal to the Vedas. Hear, I shall describe this celestial story of Vishnu... O भरत, whenever virtue suffers deterioration the lord takes an incarnation to resuscitate it...

verses.sanskrit: भवेयमहमेवार्कः सोमो वायुर्हताशनः। सलिलं चान्तरिक्षं च नक्षत्राणि दिशो दश। अहं क्रोधश्च वामश्च वरुणो वासवो यमः॥१७॥
verses.english: O grand sire, I pray for a boon of deathlessness by gods, असुरा-स्, गन्धर्वा-स्, यक्षा-स्, उरगा-स्, राक्षसा-स्, पिशाशा-स् or humans... I pray for a boon that no execratory conflagration of sages shall touch me, as they are wonted to hurl curses wrathfully... incidentally, weapons, mountains, trees, dry or wet articles or any other instruments shall not bring about my destruction.

verses.sanskrit: धनदश्च धनाध्यक्षो यक्षकिम्पुरुषाधिपः। मूर्तिमन्ति च दिव्यानि ममास्त्राणि महाहवे। उपतिष्ठन्तु देवेश सर्वलोकपितामह॥१८॥
verses.english: If ever my end comes, let it come through some living soul that is capable of felling me along with my aides, army and vehicles just with a single stroke of bare hand...

verses.sanskrit:
पितामह उवाच।
              एते दिव्या वरास्तात मया दत्तास्तवाद्भुताः। सर्वान्कामानल्पभावात्प्राप्स्यासि त्वं न संशयः॥१९॥
verses.english: The sun, moon, air, fire, water, firmament, constellations, ten cardinals, anger, desire, वरुण-raingod, इन्द्र, यम-timegod... further, कुबेर, the wealth distributing god and also the king of the यक्शा-s and किम्पुरुशा-s – shall come under my thumb...

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एवमुक्त्वा स भगवाञ्जगामाकाशमेव च। वैराज्यं ब्रह्मसदनं ब्रह्मर्षिगणसेवितम्॥२०॥
verses.english: As promised to सुग्रीव, राम anointed हिम् in that kingdom on eliminating his brother वालि in a confrontation...

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवाश्च नागाश्च गन्धर्वा सुनिभिः सह। वरप्रदानं श्रुत्वैव पितामहमुपस्थिताः॥२१॥
verses.english: On hearing about the grant of boons to हिरण्य-कशिपु, then the gods, नागा-s, गन्धर्वा-s, sages et al have rushed to brahma, and they appealed to him keeping indra in the forefront...

verses.sanskrit:
देवा ऊचुः।
              वरेणानेन भगवान्वधिष्यति स नोऽसुरः। तत्प्रसीदस्व भगवन्वधोऽप्यस्य विचिन्त्यताम्॥२२॥
verses.english: Gods said to brahma, “Oh, god, with the boons you bestowed on him that demon will now start to persecute us... nevertheless, now a thought may be given to finish him off...” hearing their appeal for the well-being of all worlds, then brahma addressed all the hosts of gods...

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              भगवान्सर्वभूतानामादिकर्ता स्वयं प्रभुः। स्रष्टा च हव्यकव्यानामव्यक्तप्रकृतिर्ध्रुवः॥२३॥
verses.english: “Oh, gods, gods should not be supposititious, isn’t it... hence, that हिरण्य-कशिपु should necessarily get boons at the end of his severe ascesis... god viShNu will take care of ending that demon and his activity as and when the result of ascesis - तपः फलम् –wanes out...” so said brahma to all gods... hearing this placation gods happily returned to their own places...

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोकहितं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा देवः प्रजापतिः। आश्वासयामास सुरान्त्सशीतैर्वचनाम्बुभिः॥२४॥
verses.english: With the potentiality of boons he obtained, हिरण्य-कशिपु started to tyrannise one and all... tormenting those sages that are busy in pious works and mortifications without recourse to any other pleasure, and those that are abiding by truth and virtue, and hermitages... defeating all the gods available in all the three worlds, and holding sway on all of them, that demon used to stay high in heaven... when that demon maddened with boon stayed on earth, he bid to perform vedic-rituals propitiating demons, but not gods, whereby gods did not get their share of offertories in rituals and remained foodless... whereupon आदित्या-स्, रुद्रा-स्, मरुत-स् et al gods sought the shelter of nArAyaNa, the ultimate shelter for one and all...

verses.sanskrit: अवश्यं त्रिदशास्तेन प्राप्तव्यं तपसः फलम्। तपसोऽन्ते स भगवान्वधं विष्णुः करिष्यति॥२५॥
verses.english: “Oh, god नारायण, save us now from the scare of हिरण्य-कशिपु... do something to give us shelter from him as well as to eradicate the progeny of lady दिति, namely the demons...” so said gods to lord विष्णु after eulogising him...

verses.sanskrit: एतच्छ्रुत्वा सुराः सर्वे वाक्यं पङ्कजजन्मनः। स्वानि स्थानानि दिव्यानि प्रतिजग्मुर्मुदान्विताः॥२६॥
verses.english: Then विष्णु said to gods, “fear no more... oh, gods... I promise you safety... soon you will regain your heaven, to boot... I will slay that demon along with his followers because he is maddened with his boon and rendered unslayable even for a best god...”

verses.sanskrit: लब्धमात्रे वरे तस्मिन्त्सर्वाः सोऽबाधत प्रजाः। हिरण्यकशिपुर्दैत्यो वरदानेन दर्पितः॥२७॥
verses.english: The gods and sages are termed as पुष्करा-s because they are manifest from brahma, who manifested from the golden lotus with thousand petals, which in turn is a manifest from the naval of कमल-नाभ, say shrIhari, while he is reposing on the oceanic waters... this is how the purANA-s, that echo the teachings of veda-s and shruti-s, tell us...

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमेषु मुनीन्सर्वान्ब्राह्मणान्त्संशितव्रतान्। सत्यधर्मरतान्दान्तान्धर्षयामास वीर्यवान्॥२८॥
verses.english: O slayer of enemies, janamejaya, I have described to you the most wonderful and auspicious incarnation of Vishnu as I have heard... the great lord विष्णु next incarnated himself as परशु-राम, the son of sage जमदग्नि॥।

verses.sanskrit: देवांतस्त्रिभुवनस्थांश्च पराजित्य महासुरः। त्रैलोक्यं वशमानीय स्वर्गे वसति दानवः॥२९॥
verses.english: Demon वि-प्रचित्ति, शिबि, शङ्कु-रय, शङ्कु, अयः-शिर, शंकु-शिर, mighty हय-ग्रीव॥। अ speedster named केतुमान्, उग्र, a great demon सोम-व्यग्र, पुष्कर, पुष्कल, वेपन, the great chariot-fighter... बृहत्-कीर्ति, महा-जिह्व, and a horse mounted demon अश्व-पति, प्रह्लाद, अश्व-शिर, कुंभ, सं-ह्राद, गगन-प्रिय, अनु-ह्राद, हरि, हर, वराह, शङ्कर, रुज... शरभ, शलभ, कुपन, कोपन, क्रथ, बृहत्-कीर्ति, महा-जिह्व, शङ्कु-कर्ण, महा-स्वन... दीर्घ-जिह्व, अर्क-नयन, मृदु-चाप, मृदु-प्रिय, वायु, यविष्ठ, नमुचि, शंबर, वि-ज्वर॥। चन्द्र-हन्त, क्रोध-हन्त, क्रोध-वर्धन, कालक, कालकेय, वृत्र, क्रोध, विरोचन॥। गरिष्ठ, वरिष्ठ, प्र-लम्ब, नरक, इन्द्र-तापन, वातापि, केतुमान्, बल-दर्पित, अक बल-अभिमानि... असि-लोम, पुलोम, वाक्-कलह, प्रमद, मद, स्व-सृम, काल-वदन, कराल, कैशिक, शर, एक-अक्ष, चन्द्र-हा, राहु, सं-ह्राद, सृमर, and स्वन... And they attacked shrIhari wielding the following weapons:

verses.sanskrit: यदा वरमदोन्मत्तश्वोदितः कालधर्मणा। यज्ञियानकरोद्वैत्यान्दैवतानप्ययज्ञियान्॥३०॥
verses.english: शत-घ्नि= weapon kills a hundred foes at a time– now named for a canon; चक्र-हस्ताः= disks in hands; परिघ-पाणयः= bludgeons in hand; महा-शिला-प्रहरणाः= catapults throwing massive stones; शूल-हस्ताः= spears in hand; अश्व-यन्त्र-आयुध = horse-like machines [may be robots]; भिण्डि-पाल-आयुधाः= weapons called भिण्डि-पाल; शूल= tridents; उलूखल= pestle-like weapons; परश्व= axes; पाश= nooses; मुद्गर= batterers; मुद्गल= shillelagh-like weapons...

verses.sanskrit: तदादित्याश्च साध्याश्च विश्वे च वसवस्तथा। रुद्रा देवगणा यक्षा देवद्विजमहर्षयः॥३१॥
verses.english: Thus wielded numerous and horrible weapons... and changed their guise to look as:

verses.sanskrit: शरण्यं शरणं विष्णुसुपतस्तुर्महाबलम्। देवं देवमयं यज्ञं ब्रह्म दैवं सनातनम्॥३२॥
verses.english: कूर्म= tortoise; कुक्कुट= cock; वक्त्राः= faced demons; शशि= hare; उलूक= owl; मुखाः= faced; खर= ass; उष्ट्र वदनाः = camel faced ones; वराह-वदनाः= boar-faced demons; भीमा मकर-वक्त्राः = mighty, crocodile, faced ones; क्रोष्टु वक्त्राः= jackal faced ones; आखु= mouse; दर्दुर=tortoise; वक्त्राः= faced ones; वृक मुखाः= fox faced ones; मार्जार= cat; गज= elephant; वक्त्राः= faced ones; महा वक्त्राः= bizarre faced ones; नक्र= ewe faced ones; मेष आनना= ram faced ones; go= cow faced; अज= goat faced; महिष आननाः= buffalo faced ones; गोधा= mongoose faced; शल्यक वक्त्राः = porcupine faced ones; क्रौञ्च वक्त्राः= heron faced ones; गरुड आननाः= eagle faced; खड्ग-मुखा= rhinoceros faced ones; मयूर वदनाः= peacock faced ones.

verses.sanskrit:
भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च प्रजालोकनमस्कृतम्।
              देवा ऊचुः।
              नारायण महाभाग देव त्वां शरणं गताः॥३३॥
verses.english: With regard to their dressing pattern, some are clad in elephant-skins, some in antelope skin, some have ordinary clothing around their bodies, while others have jute cloths, some wearing half-crowns, some wearing ear-rings, some wearing crowns, some with long tufts of lair, some with conch-like necks... thus a numberless दैत्या-s, wearing various dresses, adorned with diverse garlands and taking up their burning weapons, the powerful हृषीकेश surrounded of all sides, while that हृषीकेश is taking strides on three worlds...

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि नः परमो धाता त्वं हि नः परमो गुरुः। त्वं हि नः परमो देवो ब्रह्मादीनां सुरोत्तम॥३४॥
verses.english: That being so, when श्रीहरि enlarged his body and placed first footstep on the earth making it a pebble encased under the hollow of his foot, then the sun and the moon seemed slithering to his breast level; when he placed second footstep in the sky shrouding all heavens, then the sun and moon seemed to be further foundering to his naval level; and when he grew his body further and placed his third footstep enshrouding the triad of worlds, then the sun and moon seemed to have slipped to his knee level... this is how scholars of yore say about the illimitable expansile nature of viShNu – व्यापकत्वात् विष्णुः... thus conquering all demons viShNu retrieved the earth and heaven, and proffered heaven to indra...

verses.sanskrit: त्वं पद्मामलपत्राक्ष शत्रुपक्षभयावह। क्षयाय दितिवंशस्याक्षयाय भव नः प्रभो॥३५॥
verses.english: Thus have I described the dwarf-boy incarnation of विष्णु to you, which the vedic-scholars of yore narrate as the magnificence of विष्णु...

verses.sanskrit:
त्रायस्व जहि दैत्येन्द्रं हिरण्यकशिपुं प्रभो।
              विष्णुरूवाच।
              भयं त्यजध्वममरा अभयं वो ददाम्यहम्॥३६॥
verses.english: At another time, विष्णु, the soul of all, incarnated himself as the highly forgiving दत्त-आत्रेय. When the veda-s disappeared, religious works and Vedic rituals slackened, four-caste system became hotchpotch, when dharma is collapsing and a-dharma is on the rise, when truth is lost and untruth flourished, when all people are about to face a cultural perish, when dharma is floundering in the morass of a-dharma, lord दत्तात्रेय re-established the four Vedas with their rituals, and re-categorised the four caste system, as well...

verses.sanskrit: तथैव त्रिदिवं देवाः प्रतिपत्स्यथ मा चिरम्। एष तं सगणं दैत्यं वरदानेन दर्पितम्॥३७॥
verses.english: Thus the thousand-headed god विष्णु re-established the earth together with its mountains, forests and hinterlands, upraising it from the abyss with his fangs from the diluvial sheet of water under which she is submersed, which he has done on becoming a sacred-boar for the benefit of all living beings...

verses.sanskrit: अवध्यममरेन्द्राणां दानवेन्द्रं निहन्म्यहम्॥३८॥
verses.english: O slayer of enemies, janamejaya, I have described to you the most wonderful and auspicious incarnation of Vishnu as I have heard... the great lord विष्णु next incarnated himself as परशु-राम, the son of sage जमदग्नि॥।

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान्विसृज्य त्रिदिवौकसः। वधं सङ्कल्पयित्वा तु हिरण्यकशिपोः प्रभुः॥३९॥
सोऽचिरेणैव कालेन हिमवत्पार्वमागतः। किं नु रूपं समास्थाय निहन्म्यने महासुरम्॥४०॥
verses.english: Hauling the king Arjuna from his chariot onto earth, taunting him at will, chopping his thousand arms with his ruthless axe, परशु-राम hacked him to death, throughout which process king कार्तवीर्य had been bellowing like a cloud... later, परशु-राम eliminating all the kinsmen of कार्तवीर्य, he also eliminated hosts of kshatriya-s who have been sprawling so far on Mt. मेरु and Mt. मन्दर as if caparisoning those mountains... thus, he has undertaken the elimination kshatriya-s from the face of the earth in twenty-one rounds, and he achieved it...

verses.sanskrit: यत्सिद्धिकरमाशु स्याद्वधाय विबुधद्विषः। अनुत्पन्नं ततश्चक्रे सोऽत्यन्तं रूपमास्थितः॥४१॥
verses.english: On divesting the earth of the kshatriya-s, the great ascetic परसु-राम, the son of ब्ऱ्हिगु, undertook the performance of a horse-sacrifice for the expiation of all his sins... in that sacrifice consisting of profuse gifts, that highly liberal and illustrious परशु-राम, the foremost of chariot-warriors, made presents of quick-coursing horses, chariots, endless gold, kine and elephants... he also gifted the earth to मरीचि'स् son काश्यप-प्रजापति with a great delight... hence, mother earth is also termed as काश्यपि...

verses.sanskrit: नारसिंहमनाधृष्यं दैत्यदानवरक्षसास्। सहायं तु महाबाहुर्जग्राहोङ्कारमेव च॥४२॥
verses.english: On his becoming चिरन्जीवि – never perishing entity – परशु-राम is frequently moving in all the three worlds for the welfare of one and all with a bodily glow of his utmost ascesis, even today... that courageous one abides on the most excellent Mt. महेन्द्र like a titular god... this is how the lord of gods, विष्णु, an everlasting, imperishable, eternal entity, incarnated as परशु-राम, the son of sage जमदग्नि...

verses.sanskrit: अथोङ्कारसहायोऽसौ भगवान्विष्णुरधव्ययः। हिरण्यकशिपोः स्थानं जगाम प्रभुरिश्वरः॥४३॥
verses.english: In क्ऱित era belonging to the twenty-fourth महा-युग, the lotus-petal eyed विष्णु, keeping sage vishvamitra as helmsman and making himself fourfold personalities, incarnated as the son of king दश-रथ, where the other three personalities are भरत, लक्श्मन, and शत्रुघ्न, ramified as his brothers॥। and with a resplendence like that of the sun he that lord, controller, and ambidextrous विष्णु is celebrated in this world by his name राम... and they say, that indra-like protector among humans and the lord of all beings, namely viShNu incarnated as राम, took this incarnation only to perpetuate world, to destroy demons and to stand up for virtue...

verses.sanskrit: तेजसा भास्कराकारः कान्त्या चन्द्र इवापरः। नरस्य कृत्वाऽर्धतनुं सिंहस्यार्धतनुं विभुः॥४४॥
verses.bhavadeepa: ओङ्कारसहायत्वम् ओङ्कारार्थस्य सार्वात्म्यस्यानुसन्धानं तद्बलेनैव शमादिभिः रावणादीनां निहतत्वात्॥४३॥

verses.sanskrit: नारसिंहेन वपुषा पाणिं संस्पृश्य पाणिना। ततोऽपश्यत विस्तीर्णां दिव्यां रम्यां मनोरमाम्॥४५॥
verses.english: At the outset, that exalted soul राम, on eliminating demon सुबाहु trounced his brother demon मारीच and made him hopeless of further malice, when he in his adolescence stood guard to the Vedic ritual of his mentor विश्वमित्र...

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामयुतां शुभ्रां हिरण्यकशिपोः सभाम्। विस्तीर्णां योजनशतं शतमध्यर्धमुच्छ्रिताम्॥४६॥
verses.english: Later, he snapped the bow of महेश्वर when he visited the Vedic ritual of the high-souled king जनक, effortlessly and sportily...

verses.sanskrit: विहायसीं कामगमां पञ्चयोजनमुच्छ्रिताम्। जराशोकक्लमत्यक्तां निष्प्रकम्पां शिवां शुभाम्॥४७॥
verses.english: He who is interested in the well being all creatures, that राम lived in forests for fourteen years attended by his brother लक्श्मन... he is also accompanied to forests by his beautiful wife, who is prominent among public as lady सीत, and who ever-abides herself at his side as his लक्श्मि, in the compose of goddess लक्श्मि with god विष्णु॥।

verses.sanskrit: शुभासनवतीं रम्यां ज्वलन्तीमिव तेजसा। अन्तः सलिलसंयुक्तां विहितां विश्वकर्मणा। दिव्यरत्नमयैर्वृक्षैः फलपुष्पप्रदैर्युताम्॥४८॥
verses.english: That राघव lived in forests for fourteen years as if forest-living is his severe ascesis, and while in a place called जनस्थान in those forests he embarked on to accomplish the work of the gods, namely demolition of demon-seminary... and while searching for route by which his wife सीत is abducted, he slew two accursed gandharva-s metamorphosed as most mighty demons, namely विराध and कबन्ध, forcibly detaching their lives from bodies with his arrows finned with highly refined golden handles and amazing fins, which are conformable to blazing fire, scorching sun, freezing moon, deadening lightning etc, and hurtling like the thunderbolts of indra...

verses.sanskrit: नीलपतासितश्यामैः सितैर्लोहितकैरपि। अवतानैस्तथा गुल्मैर्मञ्जरीशतधारिभिः॥४९॥
verses.english: As promised to सुग्रीव, राम anointed हिम् in that kingdom on eliminating his brother वालि in a confrontation...

verses.sanskrit: सिताम्रधनसङ्काशा प्लवन्तीवाप्सु दृश्यते। धन्यासनवती रम्या ज्वलन्ती इव तेजसा॥५०॥
verses.english: राम eliminated रावण, the king of the राक्शसा-s... where that रावण loomed as an unconquerable demon, who on obtaining a boon from brahma became interminable for the hosts of gods, or असुरा-s, or यक्ष-s, or गन्धर्व-s, or reptiles and the like; who looks like a heap of mascara, a persecutor of all worlds, whose hum itself is dreadful, who is fenced with millions of demon-stooges; who is an invincible, unbearable, self-conceited demon; at whom even the celestials cannot stare; whose onslaught will be impetuous like that a mauling tiger; who looks like a massive black cloud; whose body is colossal and whose might is surpassing; an evildoer; hell-bent on undertaking atrocities... and राम eliminated such a रावण along with all his sons, brothers, ministers, and army in a battle...
verses.bhavadeepa: अवतानैः वितानप्रान्तेषु लम्बमानैः चित्रपटैः “झालर” इति प्रसिद्धैः। गुल्मैः तेष्वेव गुच्छाकारैरवयवैः॥४९॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रभावती भास्वरा च दिव्यगन्धमनोरमा। नासुखा न च दुःखा सा न शीता न च धर्मदा॥५१॥
verses.english: Described are the incarnations of विष्णु in the past, oh king, undertaken for the behoof of mankind, now I shall now present an account of the future incarnations...

verses.sanskrit: न क्षुत्पिपासे न ग्लानिं प्राप्य तां प्राप्नुवन्ति हि। नानारुपैर्विरचिता विचित्रैरतिभास्वरैः॥५२॥
स्तम्भैर्मणिमयैर्दिव्यैः शाश्वती चाक्षता च सा। अतिचन्द्रं च सूर्यं च पावकं च स्वयम्प्रभा॥५३॥
verses.english: Scholars well-read in the पुराणा-s, who consider राम as the source of all truths, have sung this hymn in honour of that intelligent one... "राम, the king of अयोध्य, had a blue-black hue, black eyes, nectarine speech, and shinning face; arms extending up to his knees he has a beautiful countenance and leonine shoulders. That high-souled king राम ruled the kingdom for eleven thousand years, in which kingdom the chanting of the ऱिक्, यजुर् and साम Vedas is continually heard, along with the twang of bows, together with encouraging the utterances like: make gifts to people... feast the people with finest viands..." The energetic and accomplished son of दशरथ, namely राम, shinning in his own effulgence, surpassed even the sun and the moon in his lustre. Having celebrated hundreds of holy sacrifices with perfect and most excellent gifts the highly powerful राघव left अयोध्य and repaired to the celestial region Having thus brought about the destruction of demon रावण with all his kinsmen, the omniscient and mighty-armed राम, the descendant of इक्श्वाकु dynasty, returned to the region of the celestials... Having thus brought about the destruction of demon रावण with all his kinsmen, the omniscient and mighty-armed राम, the descendant of इक्श्वाजु-s, returned to the region of the celestials...

verses.sanskrit: दीप्यते नाकपृष्ठस्था भर्त्सयन्तीव भास्करम्। सर्वे च कामाः प्रचुरा ये दिव्या ये च मानुषाः॥५४॥
verses.english: Next is the famous incarnation of विष्णु as केशव, aka क्ऱिष्ण, in the city of मथुर for the behoof of mankind, in which that mighty केशव eliminated some demons and demonic kings like: शाल्व, मैन्द, द्विविद, कंस, अरिष्ट, ऋषभ, केशि, a maidservant of demons called पूतन, a serpent called कालीय, an elephant named कुवलय-पीड, two wrestlers named चाणूर and मुष्टिक... केशव slew one demon named बाण-असुर, after chopping off his thousand arms; he also eliminated a demon called नरक-असुर, and an invader called काल-यवन together with their forces while battling with them...

verses.sanskrit: रसवन्तः प्रभूताश्च भक्ष्यभोज्यं तथाऽक्षयम्। पुण्यगन्धाः स्रजस्तत्र नित्यपुष्पफलद्रुमाः॥५५॥
verses.english: After the ninth incarnation of विष्णु, the lord having sent beforehand sage जातूकर्न to study veda-s and purANA-s, took his birth as sage वेद-व्यास in the twenty-eighth द्वापर era, to segregate one veda in four sections, and even to categorise purANA-s, for easy comprehensibility... This sage वेद-व्यास, engendered by lady सत्यवति, is the originator for the dynasty of भारता-s...

verses.sanskrit: उष्णे शीतानि तोयानि शीते चोष्णानि सन्ति वै। पुष्पिताग्रान्महाशाखान्प्रवालाकुरधारिणः॥५६॥
verses.english: Later, राम eliminated a demon called लवण-असुर, who is a son of a demon called मधु, in a place called मधु-वन, who happens to be अ सेल्फ़्-cओन्cएइतेद् देमोन् owing to a boon... like this राम eliminated many other demons that are experts in combats...

verses.sanskrit: लतावितानसञ्च्छन्नान्त्सरित्सु च सरस्सु च। मनोहरांश्च विविधान्ददर्श स तदा प्रभुः॥५७॥
verses.english: After the tenth incarnation –एकादशो, दशमे अतीते – विष्णु is going to appear as कल्कि in the house of a brAhmaNa by name विश्नु-यश in a remote village called शम्भल for the well-being of mankind... before that, he sends sage याज्ञवल्क and other sages to engage themselves in the refutation of क्शणिक-वाद- भाव्य-संपन्ना-s, or as a matter of fact, any other kinds of materialism – पाषण्ड, वितण्ड- वादा-s – because they always harp on atheistic theories... this is to make the ritualism to prevail over all other the isms...

verses.sanskrit: द्रुमान्बहुविधांस्तत्र मृगेन्द्रो ददृशे द्रुतम्। गन्धवन्ति च पुष्पाणि रसवन्ति फलानि च॥५८॥
verses.english: Later, on eradicating all those that are clinging to materialism or its other shades - भाविन-अर्थेन चोदितान् – विष्णु will relinquish his कल्कि incarnation at the medial province of the rivers गन्ग and यमुन...

verses.sanskrit: तानि शीतानि तोयानि तत्र तत्र सरांसि च। अपश्यत्सर्वतीर्थानि सभायां शततो विभुः॥५९॥
verses.english: Later, in the wee years of कलि-युग, when verboten occurs in families as one will be hijacking other man’s wife; when all the kings will be destroying mutually together with their ministers and soldiers; when there will be none to look after the people because the powers that be eases out; when one will always be at feud and larceny with the other; when all will be put to stress and strain, then the कलि-युग comes to an end havocking all the people...

verses.sanskrit: नलिनैः पुण्डरीकश्चै शतपत्रैः सुगन्धिभिः। रक्तैः कुवलयर्नीलैः कुमुदैः संयुतानी च॥६०॥
verses.english: After the termination of the कलि-युग the सत्य-युग will again appear in due order. This is the outcome of the natural sequence and there can no perversion of it.

verses.sanskrit: सकान्तैर्धाराष्ट्रेश्च राजहंसैः सुरप्रियैः। कादम्बैश्चक्रवाकैश्च सारसैः कुररैरपि॥६१॥
verses.english: The sages conversant with the knowledge of brahma have recorded these and various other incarnations of god with divine attributes in purANA-s, by the chanting of which even the gods are charmed... this eulogizing of incarnations commensurate with the teachings of श्रुति-s and पुराणा-s... if anyone recapitulates these legends, of विष्णु of unlimited power, by listening or by reciting, then his ancestral manes of will be delighted with adjoined palms... further, by listening to the illusive sports of विष्णु, the lord of yogic power, everyone is freed from all his sins and he acquires virtue, prosperity, wealth and various objects of enjoyment, by the favour of that lord viShNu...

verses.sanskrit: विमलस्फटिकाभानि पाण्डुराष्टदलानि च। कलहंसोपगीतानि सारिकाभिरुतानि च॥६२॥
गन्धवत्यः शुभास्तत्र पुष्पमञ्जरिधारिणीः। दृष्टवान्पादपाग्रेषु नानापुष्पधरा लताः॥६३॥
केतकाशोकसरलाः पुन्नागतिलकार्जुनाः। चूता नीपा नागपुष्पाः कदम्बबकुला धवाः॥६४॥
प्रियङ्गुपाटलीवृक्षाः शाल्मल्यः सहरिद्रकाः। शालास्तालाः प्रियालाश्च चम्पकाश्च मनोरमाः॥६५॥
तथा चान्ये व्यराजन्त सभायां पुष्पिता द्रुमाः। वैदुमाश्च द्रुमानीका दावाग्निज्वलितप्रभाः॥६६॥
स्कन्धवन्तः सुशाखाश्च बहुतालसमुच्छ्रयः। अञ्जनाशोकवर्णाभा भान्ति वञ्जुलका दुमाः॥६७॥
वरणा वत्सनाभाश्च पनसाञ्चन्दनैः सह। नीलाः सुमनसश्चैव पीताम्लाश्वत्थतिन्दुकाः॥६८॥
प्राचीनामलका लोध्रा मल्लिका भद्रदारवः। आम्रातकास्तथा जम्बूलकुचाः शैलवालुकाः॥६९॥
सर्जार्जुनाः कन्दुरवाः पतङ्गाः कुटजास्तथा। रक्ताः कुरबकाश्चैव नीपाश्चागरुभिः सह॥७०॥
verses.english: With the potentiality of boons he obtained, हिरण्य-कशिपु started to tyrannise one and all... tormenting those sages that are busy in pious works and mortifications without recourse to any other pleasure, and those that are abiding by truth and virtue, and hermitages... defeating all the gods available in all the three worlds, and holding sway on all of them, that demon used to stay high in heaven... when that demon maddened with boon stayed on earth, he bid to perform vedic-rituals propitiating demons, but not gods, whereby gods did not get their share of offertories in rituals and remained foodless... whereupon आदित्या-स्, रुद्रा-स्, मरुत-स् et al gods sought the shelter of nArAyaNa, the ultimate shelter for one and all...

verses.sanskrit: कदम्बाश्चैव भव्याश्च दाडिमीबीजपूरकाः। कालीयका दुकूलाश्च हिङ्गवस्तेलपर्णिकाः॥७१॥
खर्जूरा नालिकेराश्च पूरावृक्षा हरीतकी। मधूकाः सप्तपर्णाश्च बिल्वाः पारावतास्तथा॥७२॥
verses.english: After the tenth incarnation –एकादशो, दशमे अतीते – विष्णु is going to appear as कल्कि in the house of a brAhmaNa by name विश्नु-यश in a remote village called शम्भल for the well-being of mankind... before that, he sends sage याज्ञवल्क and other sages to engage themselves in the refutation of क्शणिक-वाद- भाव्य-संपन्ना-s, or as a matter of fact, any other kinds of materialism – पाषण्ड, वितण्ड- वादा-s – because they always harp on atheistic theories... this is to make the ritualism to prevail over all other the isms...

verses.sanskrit: पनसाश्च तमालाश्च नानागुल्मलतावृताः। लताश्च विविधाकाराः पत्रपुष्पफलोपगाः॥७३॥
एते चान्ये च बहवस्तत्र काननजा दुमाः। नानापुष्पफलोपेता व्यराजन्त समन्ततः॥७४॥
चकोराः शतपत्राश्च मत्तकोकिलसारिकाः। पुष्पितान्फलिताम्रांश्च सम्पतन्ति महानुमान्॥७५॥
रक्तपीतारुणास्तत्र पादपाग्रगता द्विजाः। परस्परमवैक्षन्त प्रहृष्टा जीवजीवकाः॥७६॥
